lines.zh: 孔雀迈着不紧不慢的步子
lines.en: The peacock walks at an unhurried pace.

lines.zh: 长尾拖在身后，随步轻摆
lines.en: Its long train trails and sways.

lines.zh: 它每一步都把脚抬得很高
lines.en: It lifts each foot high.
The crest bobs on its head.
It walks the edge of the yard.
Its train rasps along the ground.
It stops to look back.

lines.zh: 它的头一顿一顿地前进
lines.en: Its head jerks forward with each step.

lines.zh: 它走到阴影里，颜色暗下来
lines.en: It moves into shade and its colours dim.
It sidesteps a stone.

lines.zh: 它走过的地方留下一道痕
lines.en: Its train leaves a line behind.

lines.zh: 它张开一侧翅膀，保持平衡
lines.en: One wing opens to steady it.

lines.zh: 它跨上台阶，尾羽跟着上
lines.en: It steps up; the train follows.

lines.zh: 它慢慢地巡视自己的地盘
lines.en: It makes a slow survey of its ground.
It stops only once on high ground.

lines.zh: 风把它的尾羽吹开一点
lines.en: The wind parts its train slightly.

lines.zh: 孔雀站着，尾羽合在身后
lines.en: The peacock stands, train folded behind.
It turns its head slowly aside.
Its neck feathers shine blue.
It shakes out and settles its feathers.

lines.zh: 它抬起一只脚，迟迟不落
lines.en: It holds a foot up, not yet down.
It pecks the ground once.

lines.zh: 它把尾羽微微抬起又放下
lines.en: The train lifts slightly, then falls.
It cocks its head at its own shadow.
Its crest sways gently.
It goes suddenly still.
Its eyes are bright and watchful.
It turns its body slowly.
The peacock lifts its head to face you.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让你看清我的冠羽。
lines.en: I turn sideways so you can see my crest.
Its crest stands straight.

lines.zh: 尾屏没开，先把你打量一遍。
lines.en: No display yet — I size you up first.
It steps forward and stops.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的靴扣，反光很好看。
lines.en: I stare at your boot buckle; it shines nicely.
It half opens its wings and shakes them.
Its train loosens a little.

lines.zh: 它似乎不太把你当回事
lines.en: It does not seem much impressed.
It slowly looks away.
The peacock shrieks and springs away.
A few train feathers come loose.
It flaps back two steps.
It pulls the train in tight.
Its crest goes flat.
It runs off side-on, wings shut.
Its breathing quickens.
It stops and looks back.
It calls twice, sharply.
It retreats behind a tree.

lines.zh: 孔雀朝你手上的东西走来
lines.en: The peacock walks toward your hand.
It pecks the food up quickly.

lines.zh: 啄完它抬头看你还有没有
lines.en: Done, it looks up for more.
It circles to your other side to wait.
It pecks too fast and drops some.
Finishing, it shakes its crest.
It follows a few steps.
It circles at your feet.
Nothing else holds its interest.
Full, it simply turns away.
The peacock hops a step clear.

lines.zh: 它的尾羽被踩到了一点
lines.en: A bit of its train is stepped on.
It hurriedly pulls the train free.
It steps aside, politely.
A wing brushes your leg.
It backs off and looks back.

lines.zh: 它把身体摆正，很在意形象
lines.en: It straightens up, mindful of appearances.

lines.zh: 它抖了抖被碰过的羽毛
lines.en: It shakes the touched feathers out.
Then it strolls off again.
As if nothing had happened.

lines.zh: 孔雀把尾羽高高立起来
lines.en: The peacock raises its train high.

lines.zh: 尾羽张开成一大片眼斑
lines.en: The train fans into a field of eyes.
It sways side to side.

lines.zh: 羽毛在光里闪出绿和金
lines.en: The feathers flash green and gold.

lines.zh: 它侧过身，给对方最好的角度
lines.en: It turns to give the best angle.

lines.zh: 它抖了抖尾羽，沙沙作响
lines.en: It rattles the train.

lines.zh: 对方走近，它便收了半步
lines.en: The other nears; it eases back.
They walk slowly around each other.
At last the train folds shut.

lines.zh: 这一场展示结束得很安静
lines.en: The display ends quietly.
The peacock pecks the food up.
It shakes the food before swallowing.
It takes several pecks to finish.
It holds the item at its beak tip.

lines.zh: 我的尾羽一开，谁也别抢。
lines.en: One spread of my train and no one takes it.

lines.zh: 它把食物丢给脚边的同伴
lines.en: It drops the food for a companion.
It searches out the fallen crumbs.
It eats with an eye coming up.
Done, it wipes its beak.
It walks slowly back into the open.
The peacock stops dead.
Its crest shoots up.
Its wings half open.
It gives a shrill call.

lines.zh: 它转身朝你压过来一步
lines.en: It turns and advances a step.
Its train goes taut behind it.
It ducks its head and stares.
It starts shifting side to side.
Your approach startled it.
It has decided not to retreat.
The peacock mirrors your movement.
It stays side-on rather than charging.
Its wings stay half spread.
It presses in, then pulls back.
Half the train is fanned.

lines.zh: 它在让自己的样子更大
lines.en: It is making itself look bigger.
It hops once.
It gives a run of short calls.
Its eyes have not left you.
It circles, hunting an angle.
The peacock leaps and rakes with its feet.
Its beak jabs your hand.
A wing beats across your face.
It bumps your shin.

lines.zh: 我啄中你的手背，随即跳开。
lines.en: I peck the back of your hand and spring away.
The train sweeps your leg.
Its claws rake the ground.
It calls once after the blow.
It backs half a step, wings still open.
It charges again, quickly.
A fleck of blue appears across the yard.
The peacock steps out of the shade.
It stops in the light and lifts its head.

lines.zh: 尾羽在身后拖成一长条
lines.en: Its train trails in a long line.

lines.zh: 它走了几步，尾羽跟着摆
lines.en: It walks; the train sways after.
It shakes out all its feathers.
The crest sways on its head.
It lifts the train a little.
It surveys the place.
Then it notices you.
Singed feathers set it flapping wildly.
It lands in a heap.

lines.zh: 翅膀湿了，它拍得很吃力
lines.en: Wet wings beat heavily.

lines.zh: 冲击把它掀得翻了个身
lines.en: The blast flips it over.
An arrow passes through the train into the dirt.
Odd force scatters its feathers.

lines.zh: 饿得站不直，它还在啄地
lines.en: Starving, it still pecks at the ground.

lines.zh: 雷击让它僵住，羽全炸起
lines.en: Lightning locks it, feathers all on end.

lines.zh: 虚空拖它，翅膀抓不住空气
lines.en: The void pulls; its wings find no air.
